issues.title: Can't replace welcome image
issues.body:
The welcome screen includes a configurable logo.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/122963292-0a796500-d37e-11eb-80e3-fb2dca1d46ca.png)

The logo can be edited from the Admin Pages:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/122963390-211fbc00-d37e-11eb-93fc-dc47093c9e0d.png)

A Game Designer has reported that he wasn't able to replace the welcome image.

He uploaded the replacement via the Admin pages, but the welcome page just displayed a broken link icon.


I was able to modify the image from a `yarn develop` running instance:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/122962788-a9ea2800-d37d-11eb-9a13-e303592d69f4.png)


_Maybe_ this is an issue related to deployed (executable) Serge.

comments.body: Aah, got it.  I encountered the same issue when running Serge from the executable. My _guess_ is that the node backend is trying to write to a folder structure as if it's being run via `yarn start` - but really it needs to write the file into the `serge/img` local folder.  Note:  I tried copying the image by hand into that folder, but I still got `image not found` and the accessible text label was shown instead.
